Overcome removes the displayed random card (non-Basic preferred; skips previously skipped cards and same-type duplicates). Hold On costs 3 + number of previous holds HP (unblockable, escalates without cap) and rerolls the displayed card. Page after the n-th hold is HOLD_ON_{suffix(n-1)} (suffix = n, 'LOOP' when >=7) with a hold option HOLD_ON_{suffix(n)}; modeled pages HOLD_ON_0..HOLD_ON_6 and HOLD_ON_LOOP. Hold option damage on a page = 3 + holds already taken when it is clicked. Overcome option key is always INITIAL.options.OVERCOME. NOTE: page names/hp values on the HOLD_ON_k pages are my reconstruction of the string-built keys; hp on page HOLD_ON_k option = 3 + (k+1) because k+1 holds were already taken when that page is shown.
